name: Shimotsuki Kazumi
source: The oldest of the three sisters. She is very kind and gentle as well as relaxed. She usually comforts [url=/c14008]Futaba[/url] when the latter feels sad, but will also sometimes tease her and tell her to be honest with herself. Kazumi has the ability to survive through any kind of situation, no matter how hard or tough it is.
